evidence: Same piece as in the ROS-Amb-G-084 video (VID/frames/v16, the videographer's ROS-1). Video frame 03 has the same S-layout as DSC_3609, with the one odd orange bead in the same lower-right spot. Frame 00 matches the pile shots 3594/3605 and frame 10 the spiral 3614. Also matches: olive-yellow round beads, 4 lens spacers, long-necked gourd shaheed with collar, 4-bead tail with carved rose bead and end piece, red cord. p10ros1.jpg (the NEW still) is the same S-layout.

Not ROS-Amb-G-084 and not the same rosary as S80-ROS1. It is a twin from the same lot and turner: same olive-yellow mottled round beads, same lens spacers, carved rose تمليكة, red cord, and the same bead layout (counted about 49 beads both times). But the fixed fittings differ. S80-B has a CONICAL shaheed (cone body, sharp collar, knob on top) where ROS1/084 has a smooth long-necked gourd. S80-B's end piece is a bulb with a pointed top and a bell base where ROS1's is collar + bulb + small tip. ROS1's distinct orange bead is absent here. Catalog files the identical olive material (084) under German amber, so the category is ROS-Amb-G. No olive round piece with a conical shaheed in any gallery (checked Amb-G-003/024/081/082, ROS-045, ROS-S-005).
alternatives: ROS-Amb-G-084 (rejected: different shaheed and end piece)
visual: Olive / lemon-olive opaque round beads with fine granular mottling, about 45–50 beads separated by 4 thin lens spacers, conical turned shaheed with collar and knob, 4-bead tail with carved rose bead and pointed bulb end piece, red cord, no tassel.

evidence: Two backlit macro shots of a round bead on red cord. The photographer ends each piece with macros/backlit shots and starts the next with a pile shot, and ROS2's first frame is the pile 3536, so 3512/3517 close out the S80-B run (3475–3499). Visually: a round, slightly oblate bead with granular mottling and no swirl lines. The out-of-focus neighbouring beads are pale olive-yellow. ROS2's beads are elongated reddish-orange marbled ovals with flow swirls, which does not fit. Not S80-A (shot earlier, 3432–3469, striped beads).

NOT ROS-Amb-G-085: the 085 video (v18) shows cream / red-brown mottled CAPSULE beads, whereas these are reddish-orange marbled ovals. Closest catalog candidate ROS-027 rejected at high resolution: its beads are pointed yellow-orange olives and its tail ends in an olive cap, while S80-ROS2 has blunt oval beads with a mushroom cap and a lens + nipple end piece. ROS-043 rejected (pointed opaque olives, vase shaheed, green cord). Material uncertain: the marbled translucent orange with flow swirls looks like faturan/bakelite ('cherry amber') rather than natural amber, hence ROS.
visual: Translucent reddish-orange oval beads with darker marbled flow swirls, about 45 beads with small lens spacers, long slender bottle-neck shaheed with collar, tail of small ovals with a mushroom cap and a lens + nipple end piece, thin red cord, no tassel.

evidence: Transparent orange flattened ovals with internal parallel flow streaks on a teal-green cord. evidence: Bright cherry-red barrel beads densely flecked with black specks. The shaheed is waisted, in 3 sections, with paired metal rings.
